en: Solid company, but the hierarchy is old school. You learn a lot professionally and the team is great. What bothered me: processes are never questioned. ⟦If an instruction comes from above or from IT, it gets carried out, full stop. Asking questions is unwelcome⟧, that was made clear to me early on. The boss is also barely ever available, everything runs through his assistant. Frustrating for independent people, fine for those who like clear orders.
